resources.string: This app opens the Scratch Cookie Cottage admin portal. Enter the website address — no /admin at the end.

Live site:
https://scratchcookiecottage.pythonanywhere.com

Notification key is the PUSH_REGISTER_SECRET from the website .env. Same value on the phone and on PythonAnywhere.
Enter a full address starting with http:// or https://
Could not reach the site. Check the address and your internet connection.
